name: Ledger Prior Close Date

RETURN IF(NOT _ok, BLANK(), CALCULATE(SUM('Balance Sheet'[value_usd]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _end))

name: Ledger Line Prior Close
expression:
VAR _c = SELECTEDVALUE('Line Item'[concept])

RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_d) || NOT _ok, BLANK(), CALCULATE(SUM('Balance Sheet'[value_usd]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _d))

name: Ledger Comparator Label
expression:
VAR _d = [Ledger Prior Close Date]
VAR _fy = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_year]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _d)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_d), BLANK(), "FY" & _fy)

name: Ledger Period Context
expression:
VAR _end = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[period_end]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
VAR _d = [Ledger Prior Close Date]
VAR _fy = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_year]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _end)
VAR _fq = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_quarter]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _end)
VAR _isfy = _end = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_year_end]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _end)
VAR _lbl = IF(_isfy, "FY" & _fy, "Q" & _fq & " FY" & _fy)
VAR _form = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[form]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), 'Balance Sheet'[concept] = "Assets", 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _end)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_end), "Select a fiscal period with a filed balance sheet",
    _lbl & " · " & FORMAT(_end, "mmm d, yyyy") & "   /   vs " & [Ledger Comparator Label] & " · " & FORMAT(_d, "mmm d, yyyy")
    & "   /   Since " & [Ledger Comparator Label] & " close   /   SEC " & _form & "   /   USD")

name: Ledger Assets Change Text
expression: VAR _v = [Ledger Total Assets Change] RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), BLANK(), IF(_v >= 0, "+", "−") & "$" & FORMAT(ABS(_v) / 1E9, "#,##0.00") & "B")

name: Ledger Equity Change Text
expression: VAR _v = [Ledger Total Equity Change] RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), BLANK(), IF(_v >= 0, "+", "−") & "$" & FORMAT(ABS(_v) / 1E9, "#,##0.00") & "B")

name: Ledger Liabilities Change Text
expression: VAR _v = [Ledger Total Liabilities Change] RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), BLANK(), IF(_v >= 0, "+", "−") & "$" & FORMAT(ABS(_v) / 1E9, "#,##0.00") & "B")

name: Ledger Assets Delta Text
expression:
VAR _t = [Ledger Assets Change Text]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_t), BLANK(), _t & " vs " & [Ledger Comparator Label])

name: Ledger Working Capital Delta Text
expression:
VAR _t = VAR _v = [Ledger Working Capital Change] RETURN ( IF(ISBLANK(_v), BLANK(), IF(_v >= 0, "+", "−") & "$" & FORMAT(ABS(_v) / 1E9, "#,##0.00") & "B"))
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_t), BLANK(), "Working capital · " & _t & " vs " & [Ledger Comparator Label])

name: Ledger Gross Debt Delta Text
expression:
VAR _t = VAR _v = [Ledger Gross Debt Change] RETURN ( IF(ISBLANK(_v), BLANK(), IF(_v >= 0, "+", "−") & "$" & FORMAT(ABS(_v) / 1E9, "#,##0.00") & "B"))
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_t), BLANK(), _t & " vs " & [Ledger Comparator Label])

name: Ledger Funding Sentence
expression:
VAR _da = [Ledger Total Assets Change]
VAR _de = [Ledger Total Equity Change]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_da) || ISBLANK(_de) || _da <= 0, "Funding comparison unavailable for this period.",
    "Equity funded " & FORMAT(DIVIDE(_de, _da), "0.0%") & " of the increase in assets.")

name: Ledger Funding Headline
expression:
VAR _de = [Ledger Total Equity Change]
VAR _dl = [Ledger Total Liabilities Change]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_de) || ISBLANK(_dl), "Funding change unavailable.",
    IF(_de >= _dl, "Equity led the increase.", "Liabilities led the increase."))

name: Ledger Identity Check Text
expression:
VAR _r = [Total Assets] - [Total Liabilities] - [Total Equity]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK([Total Assets]) || ISBLANK([Total Liabilities]) || ISBLANK([Total Equity]), "Identity check unavailable",
    "Identity check · assets − liabilities − equity = $" & FORMAT(_r / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M")

name: Ledger Current Ratio Text
expression:
VAR _p = [Ledger Prior Current Ratio]
VAR _c = [Current Ratio]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_c), "Unavailable", IF(ISBLANK(_p), "", FORMAT(_p, "0.00") & "× → ") & FORMAT(_c, "0.00") & "×")

name: Ledger Cash Ratio Text
expression:
VAR _p = [Ledger Prior Cash Ratio]
VAR _c = [Cash Ratio]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_c), "Unavailable", IF(ISBLANK(_p), "", FORMAT(_p, "0.00") & "× → ") & FORMAT(_c, "0.00") & "×")

name: Ledger Liquidity Bridge Text
expression:
VAR _a = VAR _v = [Ledger Current Assets Change] RETURN ( IF(ISBLANK(_v), BLANK(), IF(_v >= 0, "+", "−") & "$" & FORMAT(ABS(_v) / 1E9, "#,##0.00") & "B"))
VAR _l = VAR _v = [Ledger Current Liabilities Change] RETURN ( IF(ISBLANK(_v), BLANK(), IF(_v >= 0, "+", "−") & "$" & FORMAT(ABS(_v) / 1E9, "#,##0.00") & "B"))
VAR _w = VAR _v = [Ledger Working Capital Change] RETURN ( IF(ISBLANK(_v), BLANK(), IF(_v >= 0, "+", "−") & "$" & FORMAT(ABS(_v) / 1E9, "#,##0.00") & "B"))
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_a) || ISBLANK(_l), "Comparison unavailable for this period.",
    "Current assets changed by " & _a & ". Current liabilities changed by " & _l & ", leaving a " & _w & " change in working capital.")

name: Ledger Securities Uplift Text
expression:
VAR _ms = [Marketable Securities]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_ms), "Current marketable securities are not tagged for this period, so only the cash-only reading is shown.",
    "Adding current marketable securities lifts net cash by $" & FORMAT(_ms / 1E9, "#,##0.00") & "B.")

name: Ledger Filing Accession
expression:
VAR _end = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[period_end]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[accn]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), 'Balance Sheet'[concept] = "Assets", 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _end)

name: Ledger Filing Form
expression:
VAR _end = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[period_end]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[form]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), 'Balance Sheet'[concept] = "Assets", 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _end)

name: Ledger Filing Period Text
expression:
VAR _end = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[period_end]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_end), BLANK(), "Balance sheet date " & FORMAT(_end, "mmm d, yyyy"))

name: Ledger Filing Filed Text
expression:
VAR _end = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[period_end]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
VAR _f = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[filed]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), 'Balance Sheet'[concept] = "Assets", 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _end)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_f), BLANK(), "Filed with the SEC on " & FORMAT(_f, "mmm d, yyyy"))

name: Ledger Filing URL
expression:
VAR _a = [Ledger Filing Accession]
VAR _u = CALCULATE(MAX('Filing'[sec_url]), REMOVEFILTERS('Filing'), 'Filing'[accn] = _a)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_u), "https://www.sec.gov/cgi-bin/browse-edgar?action=getcompany&CIK=0001045810", _u)

name: Ledger Glance Context
expression:
VAR _end = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[period_end]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
VAR _fy = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_year]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _end)
VAR _fq = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_quarter]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _end)
VAR _isfy = _end = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_year_end]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _end)
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_end), BLANK(), IF(_isfy, "FY" & _fy, "Q" & _fq & " FY" & _fy) & " · As of " & FORMAT(_end, "mmm d, yyyy") & " · SEC " & [Ledger Filing Form])

name: Ledger Claim Reconcile Text
expression:
VAR _a = [Total Assets] VAR _l = [Total Liabilities] VAR _e = [Total Equity]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_a) || ISBLANK(_l) || ISBLANK(_e), "Unavailable: a balance-sheet total is missing for this period.",
    "Total assets $" & FORMAT(_a / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M = liabilities $" & FORMAT(_l / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M + equity $" & FORMAT(_e / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M. Residual $" & FORMAT((_a - _l - _e) / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M.")

name: Ledger Claim Coverage Text
expression:
VAR _ca = [Current Assets] VAR _cl = [Current Liabilities]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_ca) || ISBLANK(_cl) || _cl = 0, "Unavailable for this period.",
    "Current assets $" & FORMAT(_ca / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M ÷ current liabilities $" & FORMAT(_cl / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M = " & FORMAT(DIVIDE(_ca, _cl), "0.00") & "×. Working capital $" & FORMAT((_ca - _cl) / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M.")

name: Ledger Claim Cash Text
expression:
VAR _c = [Cash] VAR _d = [Gross Debt] VAR _ms = [Marketable Securities]
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_c) || ISBLANK(_d), "Unavailable for this period.",
    "Cash $" & FORMAT(_c / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M − debt $" & FORMAT(_d / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M = " & IF(_c - _d < 0, "−$", "$") & FORMAT(ABS(_c - _d) / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M. " &
    IF(ISBLANK(_ms), "Marketable securities are not tagged.", "With securities $" & FORMAT(_ms / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M: " & IF(_c + _ms - _d < 0, "−$", "$") & FORMAT(ABS(_c + _ms - _d) / 1E6, "#,##0") & "M."))

name: Ledger Stmt Reported
expression:
VAR _s = SELECTEDVALUE('Line Item'[statement])
VAR _eb = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[period_end]), REMOVEFILTERS('Line Item'), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
VAR _ei = CALCULATE(MAX('Income Statement'[period_end]), REMOVEFILTERS('Line Item'), 'Income Statement'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
VAR _ec = CALCULATE(MAX('Cash Flow'[period_end]), REMOVEFILTERS('Line Item'), 'Cash Flow'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(SELECTEDVALUE('Line Item'[concept])), BLANK(), SWITCH(_s,
    "balance_sheet", CALCULATE(SUM('Balance Sheet'[value_usd]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _eb),
    "income_statement", CALCULATE(SUM('Income Statement'[value_usd]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Income Statement'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), 'Income Statement'[period_end] = _ei),
    "cash_flow", VAR _x = 0 VAR _dur = CALCULATE(MAX('Cash Flow'[duration_days]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Cash Flow'[is_period_primary] = TRUE(), 'Cash Flow'[period_end] = _ec)
        RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Cash Flow'[value_usd]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Cash Flow'[is_period_primary] = TRUE(), 'Cash Flow'[period_end] = _ec, 'Cash Flow'[duration_days] = _dur)))

name: Ledger Stmt Comparative
expression:
VAR _s = SELECTEDVALUE('Line Item'[statement])
VAR _eb = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[period_end]), REMOVEFILTERS('Line Item'), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
VAR _ei = CALCULATE(MAX('Income Statement'[period_end]), REMOVEFILTERS('Line Item'), 'Income Statement'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
VAR _ec = CALCULATE(MAX('Cash Flow'[period_end]), REMOVEFILTERS('Line Item'), 'Cash Flow'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
VAR _pb = [Ledger Prior Close Date]
VAR _bsv = CALCULATE(SUM('Balance Sheet'[value_usd]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _pb)
VAR _bsf = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[filed]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _pb)
VAR _bsalt = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[value_usd]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _pb, 'Balance Sheet'[filed] = _bsf)
VAR _pi_fy = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_year]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _ei)
VAR _pi_fq = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_quarter]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _ei)
VAR _pi = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[date]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[fiscal_year] = _pi_fy - 1, 'Date'[fiscal_quarter] = _pi_fq, 'Date'[is_fiscal_quarter_end] = TRUE())
VAR _pc_fy = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_year]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _ec)
VAR _pc_fq = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_quarter]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _ec)
VAR _pc = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[date]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[fiscal_year] = _pc_fy - 1, 'Date'[fiscal_quarter] = _pc_fq, 'Date'[is_fiscal_quarter_end] = TRUE())
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(SELECTEDVALUE('Line Item'[concept])), BLANK(), SWITCH(_s,
    "balance_sheet", IF(ISBLANK(_bsv), _bsalt, _bsv),
    "income_statement", CALCULATE(SUM('Income Statement'[value_usd]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Income Statement'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), 'Income Statement'[period_end] = _pi),
    "cash_flow", VAR _x = 0 VAR _dur = CALCULATE(MAX('Cash Flow'[duration_days]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Cash Flow'[is_period_primary] = TRUE(), 'Cash Flow'[period_end] = _pc)
        RETURN CALCULATE(MAX('Cash Flow'[value_usd]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Cash Flow'[is_period_primary] = TRUE(), 'Cash Flow'[period_end] = _pc, 'Cash Flow'[duration_days] = _dur)))

name: Reported
expression:
VAR _v = [Ledger Stmt Reported]
VAR _c = SELECTEDVALUE('Line Item'[concept])
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), BLANK(), IF(_c = "EarningsPerShareDiluted", FORMAT(_v, "$0.00"), FORMAT(_v / 1E6, "#,##0;(#,##0);–")))

name: Comparative
expression:
VAR _v = [Ledger Stmt Comparative]
VAR _c = SELECTEDVALUE('Line Item'[concept])
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), BLANK(), IF(_c = "EarningsPerShareDiluted", FORMAT(_v, "$0.00"), FORMAT(_v / 1E6, "#,##0;(#,##0);–")))

name: Change
expression:
VAR _v = IF(ISBLANK([Ledger Stmt Reported]) || ISBLANK([Ledger Stmt Comparative]), BLANK(), [Ledger Stmt Reported] - [Ledger Stmt Comparative])
VAR _c = SELECTEDVALUE('Line Item'[concept])
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), BLANK(), IF(_c = "EarningsPerShareDiluted", FORMAT(_v, "$0.00"), FORMAT(_v / 1E6, "#,##0;(#,##0);–")))

VAR _o = SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Line Item'[concept]), "CashAndCashEquivalentsAtCarryingValue", 1, "MarketableSecuritiesCurrent", 2, "DebtSecuritiesCurrent", 3, "EquitySecuritiesFvNi", 4, "AccountsReceivableNetCurrent", 5, "InventoryNet", 6, "AssetsCurrent", 7, "Assets", 8, "LiabilitiesCurrent", 9, "LongTermDebtCurrent", 10, "LongTermDebtNoncurrent", 11, "OperatingLeaseLiabilityCurrent", 12, "OperatingLeaseLiabilityNoncurrent", 13, "Liabilities", 14, "StockholdersEquity", 15, "LiabilitiesAndStockholdersEquity", 16, "Revenues", 21, "RevenueFromContractWithCustomerExcludingAssessedTax", 22, "CostOfRevenue", 23, "CostOfGoodsAndServicesSold", 24, "GrossProfit", 25, "ResearchAndDevelopmentExpense", 26, "OperatingIncomeLoss", 27, "NetIncomeLoss", 28, "EarningsPerShareDiluted", 29, "NetCashProvidedByUsedInOperatingActivities", 31, "PaymentsToAcquirePropertyPlantAndEquipment", 32, "NetCashProvidedByUsedInInvestingActivities", 33, "PaymentsForRepurchaseOfCommonStock", 34, "PaymentsOfDividends", 35, "PaymentsOfDividendsCommonStock", 36, "NetCashProvidedByUsedInFinancingActivities", 37, BLANK())
RETURN IF(ISBLANK([Ledger Stmt Reported]) && ISBLANK([Ledger Stmt Comparative]), BLANK(), _o)

name: Accession
expression:
VAR _s = SELECTEDVALUE('Line Item'[statement])
VAR _eb = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[period_end]), REMOVEFILTERS('Line Item'), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
RETURN IF(_s <> "balance_sheet" || ISBLANK([Ledger Stmt Reported]), BLANK(), CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[accn]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _eb))

name: Ledger Statement Name
expression: SWITCH(SELECTEDVALUE('Line Item'[statement]), "balance_sheet", "Balance sheet", "income_statement", "Profit & loss", "cash_flow", "Cash flow", BLANK())

name: Ledger Statement Context
expression:
VAR _s = SELECTEDVALUE('Line Item'[statement])
VAR _eb = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[period_end]), REMOVEFILTERS('Line Item'), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
VAR _ei = CALCULATE(MAX('Income Statement'[period_end]), REMOVEFILTERS('Line Item'), 'Income Statement'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
VAR _ec = CALCULATE(MAX('Cash Flow'[period_end]), REMOVEFILTERS('Line Item'), 'Cash Flow'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE())
VAR _pb = [Ledger Prior Close Date]
VAR _bsv = CALCULATE(SUM('Balance Sheet'[value_usd]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _pb)
VAR _bsf = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[filed]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _pb)
VAR _bsalt = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[value_usd]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Balance Sheet'[period_end] = _pb, 'Balance Sheet'[filed] = _bsf)
VAR _pi_fy = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_year]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _ei)
VAR _pi_fq = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_quarter]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _ei)
VAR _pi = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[date]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[fiscal_year] = _pi_fy - 1, 'Date'[fiscal_quarter] = _pi_fq, 'Date'[is_fiscal_quarter_end] = TRUE())
VAR _pc_fy = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_year]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _ec)
VAR _pc_fq = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[fiscal_quarter]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[date] = _ec)
VAR _pc = CALCULATE(MAX('Date'[date]), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'), 'Date'[fiscal_year] = _pc_fy - 1, 'Date'[fiscal_quarter] = _pc_fq, 'Date'[is_fiscal_quarter_end] = TRUE())
VAR _f = "mmm d, yyyy"
RETURN SWITCH(_s,
    "balance_sheet", "Consolidated balance sheets · as of " & FORMAT(_eb, _f) & " and " & FORMAT(_pb, _f) & " · USD millions",
    "income_statement", "Income statement · period ended " & FORMAT(_ei, _f) & " vs " & FORMAT(_pi, _f) & " (same fiscal period, prior year) · USD millions, EPS in USD",
    "cash_flow", "Cash flows · fiscal year-to-date ended " & FORMAT(_ec, _f) & " vs " & FORMAT(_pc, _f) & " · USD millions",
    "Select a statement")

name: Short-term debt (current portion)
expression: VAR _v = [Long-Term Debt Current] RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), "Unavailable", "$" & FORMAT(_v / 1E9, "#,##0.00") & "B")

name: Operating leases (separate)
expression: VAR _v = [Operating Lease Liabilities] RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_v), "Unavailable", "$" & FORMAT(_v / 1E9, "#,##0.00") & "B")

name: Ledger Stmt Key
expression:
VAR _e = CALCULATE(MAX('Balance Sheet'[period_end]), 'Balance Sheet'[is_latest_filing] = TRUE(), REMOVEFILTERS('Date'[day_of_week]))
RETURN IF(ISBLANK(_e), BLANK(), YEAR(_e) * 10000 + MONTH(_e) * 100 + DAY(_e))
